title: QUAKE II
subtitle: id Software, 1997 · 3.19 with ref_soft — id's own Win32 client, drawing through GDI
argsHint: `+map <name>` loads a level. `+set vid_ref soft` is ref_soft.dll, id's software renderer, and `+set vid_fullscreen 0` keeps it in a window -- which is not cosmetic: rw_imp.c blits with BitBlt only under `if (!sw_state.fullscreen)` and goes through DirectDraw otherwise, and the DirectDraw path is not served here.

needsData.hint: baseq2/ from the shareware or retail release — pak0.pak

_why: The same engine as the X11 client, with only its five platform files swapped -- and three shared objects rather than one: the engine, ref_soft.dll and gamex86.dll, each with its own external namespace, each found by the program's own LoadLibrary call.
_measured: 300 frames of demo1 at 320x240 in 1.3 s, 237 rendered frames/s on the deterministic clock, 76,800 of 76,800 pixels in 140 colours. 117 translation units, 96,305 lines, 2,450 functions, compiled in 1.7 s.
